title: Kconfig: No MIN < MAX constraint on CSMA backoff range
description: LICHEN_TDMA_CONTENTION_BACKOFF_MIN_MS (range 10-5000) and LICHEN_TDMA_CONTENTION_BACKOFF_MAX_MS (range 10-10000) can be configured with MIN >= MAX (e.g., MIN=5000, MAX=100). The help text says 'uniform random in [min_ms, max_ms)' - an invalid/empty range would cause undefined behavior in the random selection code (modulo by zero or negative, wraparound, or always selecting MIN).
